title: Disconnect happens on one click
problem: One slip forgets a sign-in, and running agents lose access.
fix: Confirm inside the row, and move Disconnect away from Check.

title: A refused sign-in still looks healthy
problem: A green row says agents can push when the service refused them.
fix: Turn the row amber, say pushes will fail, offer Replace token.

title: Account status is buried in open forms
problem: Every unconnected service shows its whole form, so status is hard to scan.
fix: One status row per service; a form opens only on Connect.

title: Sign-in forms lose text and can't be closed
problem: Esc wipes typed text, opened forms stay open, errors sit far away.
fix: Add Cancel, keep text on Esc, show errors under the field.

title: Clicks and checks give no answer
problem: Check reports nothing, and clicks during another action are silently dropped.
fix: Show 'Token works, checked 2:41 PM'; disable controls while busy.

title: History's two retention controls are empty
problem: The app reads the wrong field names, so neither setting shows or changes.
fix: Read the field names the board sends; add a test; use pop-ups.

title: History deletion comes with no warning
problem: Shortening retention or Clean up now removes history at once, with no preview.
fix: Say what will go and ask first; report the true total.

title: Daily limit settings surprise the owner
problem: Changing one restarts today's count; rows and percents don't explain themselves.
fix: Keep today's count, move Today first, make notes follow the choice.

title: Buttons and menus can't be reached from the keyboard
problem: Buttons, the sidebar, the hours menu and the pill take no focus.
fix: Fix once in the shared controls: tab stops, Enter, Space, focus ring.

title: A stopped board reads as signed out
problem: Accounts says Not signed in with live forms; System looks calm.
fix: One shared banner says the board is down, with Try again.

title: Pages go stale in a window left open
problem: Usage, History, QA and Reviewers load once, or hang on 'Asking the board…'.
fix: Reload the visible page on click, on a timer and on focus.

title: Controls are cut off in a small window
problem: Below about 830 wide, Sign in, Connect and the 25% choice disappear.
fix: Let rows wrap, shrink the fields, shorten the pinned header.

title: Several colours fail contrast
problem: Placeholders, field edges, pill labels and dark badges fall under the minimums.
fix: Darken all four until each meets its minimum on its own background, then recheck the main window.

title: The selected choice is hard to see
problem: Selected segments and hours days barely differ from unselected ones.
fix: Stronger fill or edge, plus semibold text on the selected item.

title: Sections are in the wrong order and aren't remembered
problem: Daily sections sit below rare ones; size and section reset on each open.
fix: Reorder by use and restore size, position and section.

title: Content stretches across wide windows
problem: Rows spread out, so labels end up far from their controls.
fix: Cap content near 720 wide, aligned left under the title.

title: The Today part of the pill is cut off
problem: The pill overflows the sidebar, so the daily figure never shows.
fix: Make it a full-width block with one column per window.

title: The pill opens Days, not the limits
problem: Clicking the pill lands on the wrong page for changing limits.
fix: Open Settings on Usage, and say so in the tooltip.

title: Stale usage is too faint and unexplained
problem: Old numbers just fade, with no sign they are old.
fix: Drop the fade and add 'Last read 3h ago' in the pill.

title: Warm and hot look alike, and Today counts the other way
problem: The pill barely changes as limits near; Today counts down, others up.
fix: Tint the whole pill by its worst level; show used percent everywhere.

title: Today until can run agents 12 hours too long
problem: Typing 1 at 11 PM means 1 PM tomorrow, with little sign.
fix: Pick the soonest matching time and show the resolved end time.

title: A failed save or bad time goes unexplained
problem: Unsaved values stay on show, and an invalid time snaps back silently.
fix: Put back the saved value, name the failure, offer Retry.

title: Work hours have no place in Settings
problem: Half the owner's job lives only in a menu off a footer pill.
fix: Move the hours to a section under Accounts, and let the pill open it.

title: The menu's wording and placing mislead
problem: 'No work hours' reads backwards, and the menu opens at the pointer.
fix: Say 'Agents start any time'; anchor the menu to the pill.

title: All seven days can be switched off with no warning
problem: With no days picked, agents may never start and the pill can end on 'until'.
fix: Warn in the menu; make the pill say 'Agents off: no days picked'.

title: Times break the 12-hour AM/PM rule
problem: The pill and tooltips show '9am' and 'pm' instead of '9 AM'.
fix: Change the one shared time formatter to '9 AM' and '9:30 AM'.

title: First launch has no home, order or progress
problem: Setup steps are scattered over banners, pills and pages.
fix: A Setup section lists every step in order, with a count.

title: The Login Items banner stays after approval
problem: The app never rechecks, so the banner keeps asking after it's done.
fix: Recheck every few seconds and on focus; confirm when it's on.

title: Blocked, failed and Midna states are dead ends
problem: The messages conflict and give a new owner no next step.
fix: One row per cause, with the action that fixes it.

title: Hook and link failures vanish
problem: Errors disappear after 6 seconds; a failed tb link says nothing.
fix: Keep the last error on the Setup row, with Copy.

title: Reinstall can lose a working plugin
problem: It removes the plugin first; if adding it back fails, only a toast says so.
fix: Check Claude Code runs first, and put the old setup back on failure.

title: One service goes by four names
problem: Board, daemon, service and taskboardd all mean the same thing.
fix: Call it the board everywhere: Board version, Restart board. Login item names only the macOS setting. This replaces 'daemon' and 'background service' in every other fix here.

title: Every update failure says Check failed
problem: Install failures read as check failures, with a raw, faint reason.
fix: Name the failed stage; keep it visible outside Settings.

title: Update progress is thin and can go backwards
problem: No download progress, and a ready update vanishes when a newer one starts.
fix: Show MB progress, keep the ready version, guard double clicks.

title: Restart notes overpromise
problem: The update note says the board keeps running, but it restarts; success is silent.
fix: Say 'Agents keep running in Midna through a restart' (Midna runs them, not the board); report when the board is back.

title: QA unlocks only by editing a config file
problem: Jira has no home in Accounts, so QA can't be turned on here.
fix: Add a Jira card to Accounts, built like Bitbucket's.

title: Pool settings show as one sentence pointing at the CLI
problem: Settings can't be read at a glance, and 'Pool' is a filler label.
fix: Show named rows; leave editing to the CLI unless the owner says otherwise.

title: Lists hide what matters and aren't virtualized
problem: Empty states hide facts, tasks show as bare refs, rows aren't virtualized.
fix: Show titles in rows, keep project headings, use a virtual list.

title: QA's Off/On looks live when it's dead
problem: The switch can stick on and shows no saving state.
fix: Disable it properly, and show saving.

title: Small visual polish
problem: Uneven glyphs, meaningless green dots, no pressed states, small shifts.
fix: Tidy in passing when these files are next touched.
